bio_en:
Dongjun Suh is Department Chair and Associate Professor of the Department of Convergence & Fusion System Engineering and the Department of Smart Plant Engineering at Kyungpook National University (KNU), and Director of the BK21 FOUR Education and Research Group for Full-Cycle Regional Innovation Talent in the Global New Energy Industry. He previously directed the BK21 FOUR Innovative Education and Research Center for Global New Energy Industry with Climate Change (2020–2025). He joined KNU in spring 2018.

He was a visiting scholar at the University of Southern California (USC) from 2023 to 2024. He received his Ph.D. from the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (ICT Convergence Program) at KAIST.

From 2015 to 2018 he was a senior researcher at the Korea Institute of Science and Technology Information (KISTI), where he led the disaster risk analysis team for high-rise buildings (PI of the disaster project, MDCO Convergence Research Center, about 9.8 billion KRW, 2016–2019). He was also an associate professor at the Department of S&T Information Science, University of Science & Technology (UST, 2017–2018), a research assistant professor at the KAIST Institute for Information Technology Convergence (2014–2015), and a software engineer at HUMAX (2007–2010).

His research centers on big data and smart control systems: predictive analytics that combine statistical modeling, machine learning, and AI-based problem solving for large-scale infrastructure such as plants, cities, factories, buildings, and farms.
